subject: MSA & Order Form — redlines for 12-month renewal + capacity uplift
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>
To: contracts@elara.com, procurement@elara.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 3 Nov 2027 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: MSA & Order Form — redlines for 12-month renewal + capacity uplift

Hi Marta / Elara team,

Thanks again for the run-through last week. Per our conversation, Elara is ready to renew the MSA for a 12-month term and add a 35% capacity uplift across the model serving tier (exhibit B / order form). I attached a draft order form that stacks the additional capacity on top of the existing coverage.

Key asks from Elara that we flagged on the call:
- Move from 12-month auto-renew to explicit renewal (Elara requested non-auto).
- Add usage-based credit threshold for overage protection at 110% of committed tokens.
- Shorten notice period for capacity changes from 60 -> 30 days.

Attached: OrderForm_Elara_Uplift_20271103.docx (proposed redline) and a one-page pricing summary. Please review the order form redline together with the MSA. I copied Ben for commercial confirmation and Laura for signature path/contract ops.

Proposed next steps:
1) Legal review: Marta, please mark up the MSA and order form with any non-starters.
2) Commercial: Ben & I reconcile pricing and credits.
3) Sign: target DocuSign by Nov 9 to meet renewal window.

If we can get initial redlines by EOD Thursday (11/4) that would keep the cadence.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine@redwood.com
(415) 555-0198

Attachments: OrderForm_Elara_Uplift_20271103.docx

From: Marta Gomez <marta@gomezlaw.com>
To: jasmine@redwood.com, contracts@elara.com
Cc: procurement@elara.com
Date: Thu, 4 Nov 2027 11:02:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: MSA & Order Form — redlines for 12-month renewal + capacity uplift

Hi Jasmine / Elara team,

Thanks for the draft. We reviewed and have three material concerns in the MSA redline (see attached PDF):
1) Data residency / cross-border clause — Elara requires a firm commitment that production data never leaves the US region without prior written consent. The current MSA language is permissive.
2) Liability cap — Elara wants a carve-out for wilful misconduct and gross negligence; acceptable but the overall cap needs to be tied to 12 months' fees instead of 6.
3) Audit & logs — need retention details and a 30-day SLA for log delivery for auditing purposes.

On the Order Form: the 110% overage protection language is workable, but procurement asked that credits apply pro-rata and not as a one-time annual true-up.

I attached Elara_MSA_Redline_20271103.pdf with annotated comments and a clean summary page. I can walk through the redlines with your legal counsel tomorrow morning PST.

Best regards,
Marta Gomez
External Counsel, Gomez & Partners
marta@gomezlaw.com

Attachments: Elara_MSA_Redline_20271103.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: jasmine@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 4 Nov 2027 12:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MSA & Order Form — redlines for 12-month renewal + capacity uplift

Jasmine / team,

Quick note — commercial is aligned on list price and the uplift math. Two items for legal to consider from our side:
- We can accept the 12-month fee basis for the liability cap if the carve-outs are narrow (wilful misconduct only, not broad professional negligence).
- For the overage protection, we prefer a monthly pro-rata credit rather than an annual true-up to keep billing simple.

I can join the call with Marta tomorrow.

Thanks,
Ben
Director, Renewals | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: marta@gomezlaw.com, jasmine@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 5 Nov 2027 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MSA & Order Form — legal counter & proposed edits

Hi Marta / Jasmine / Ben,

Thanks for the redlines, Marta. I reviewed the PDF and attached a marked MSA with our proposed language (embedded in the PDF comments) and a short summary:
- Data residency: we propose a mutually acceptable clause that guarantees US-only production storage unless Elara requests cross-border processing in writing. We can add an export-control addendum for specific workloads.
- Liability: we can agree to a 12-month fee cap but need an explicit carve-out definition limited to criminal acts and proven intentional misconduct (we cannot accept an open-ended carve-out for negligence).
- Audit & logs: Redwood can provide a certified export of logs within 7 business days for standard audit requests; for emergency subpoenas/forensic requests we will prioritize immediate access.

On credits: we can do monthly pro-rata credits at the 110% threshold. I'll attach the updated order form with the credit calculations and the revised notice period (30 days) flagged.

Attaching: OrderForm_Elara_Uplift_20271103.docx (redline v2). Happy to take a 30-minute review call Friday 10am PST.

Regards,
Dev Patel
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
dev_patel@redwood.com

Attachments: OrderForm_Elara_Uplift_20271103_v2.docx

From: Marta Gomez <marta@gomezlaw.com>
To: dev_patel@redwood.com, jasmine@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@elara.com
Date: Mon, 8 Nov 2027 10:20:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: MSA & Order Form — legal counter & proposed edits

Dev / Jasmine,

Thanks — the changes address most of our concerns. Two remaining items:
- Data residency: Elara requires language that explicitly prohibits routing of production inference traffic through non-US regions for caching or optimization without prior written approval. Your proposed "export-control addendum" is acceptable if it contains a customer approval flow; please add the approval steps.
- Liability carve-out: Elara's board insists on including gross negligence in the carve-out. We can accept the 12-month cap if Redwood agrees to a limited insurance-backed remedy for gross negligence (we're open to a $3M fence).

Assuming those two items can be resolved, procurement is ready to proceed to DocuSign this week. See the attached final comments and a marked order form with the pro-rata credit language.

Best,
Marta

Attachments: Elara_MSA_Redline_20271108.pdf, OrderForm_Elara_Uplift_20271103_v2.docx

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>
To: marta@gomezlaw.com, procurement@elara.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 9 Nov 2027 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MSA & Order Form — legal counter & proposed edits

Marta / Elara procurement,

Appreciate the quick review and the clear asks. Summary of our commitments to unblock sign:
1) Data residency: Dev will add explicit approval flow language preventing routing through non-US regions for production inference; Redwood will include a one-page addendum describing the approval process.
2) Liability: Redwood can accept inclusion of gross negligence in the carve-out provided we add an insurance-backed remedy cap of $3M. Dev will include the insurance language in the MSA.
3) Credits & notice: monthly pro-rata credits at 110% threshold and notice period reduced to 30 days (as redlined).

Action items and timeline:
- Dev: finalize MSA redline reflecting the two points above by EOD Wednesday 11/10.
- Laura: prepare DocuSign envelope and add signatories (Redwood + Elara) once final redline is in.
- Ben & I: confirm final invoice and billing cadence; target first invoice with uplift on Dec 1.

DocuSign link (will be live once Laura uploads): https://www.docusign.net/link/ABC123-elara-orderform
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/ELR-2027-042

If that timeline works, we'll route to signatures immediately once Dev drops the MSA. Thanks everyone for moving quickly on this.

-Jasmine
